content.premise: The keep's last warden has stopped speaking to travellers who do not read. A slate on the wall of the entry hall, a lever in a side room, an empty stand at the gate, and a great hall he has withdrawn to — the keep answers what you do, and only that.
content.theme: A small stone keep that tells you nothing: no marker over the thing to press, no line in chat, nothing on screen but the room.
content.title: The Quiet Room
